page.content:
Chinese writing material that traveled west to the Islamic world.

How Paper connects

  • Location: Baghdad — Paper-making took root in the Abbasid world after arriving from the east.
  • Location: Samarkand — Samarkand is the traditional first western paper center on the road.

What is Paper?

Paper, long used in Han China, reached Samarkand and then Abbasid cities after the eighth century. It multiplied books along the same routes that had carried silk.

Key threads lead to Baghdad and Samarkand.
